title: Library Hours Extended During Finals
content: The central library will be open 24/7 from July 28 through August 5 during finals week. Additional study pods have been reserved on floors 2 and 3.

title: Campus Network Maintenance — Thursday Night
content: Expect intermittent Wi-Fi outages across campus this Thursday between 11 PM and 3 AM. Plan offline study sessions accordingly.

title: Fall Career Fair Registration Now Open
content: Register now for the Fall Career Fair on August 15. Over 80 companies are attending, including Google, Microsoft, and several top research labs. Early registration ends July 30.

title: New Vegan Options in South Dining Hall
content: Expanded plant-based menu options are now available daily at the South Dining Hall. A full allergen guide is posted at the entrance.

title: Security Alert: Phishing Emails Targeting Students
content: IT Security has flagged a wave of phishing emails claiming your tuition is overdue. Do not click any links — forward suspicious emails to security@university.edu.

title: Academic Integrity Workshop — Mandatory for Freshmen
content: All first-year students must attend one Academic Integrity Workshop session before August 1. Sessions run daily at 10 AM and 2 PM in the Student Union.

title: Scholarships Deadline Extended to August 5
content: The deadline for the Merit Excellence Scholarship and the STEM Research Grant has been extended to August 5. Submit applications via the Student Portal.

title: Parking Permit Renewals Open
content: Annual parking permits for the 2025–26 academic year are now available for renewal online. Permits not renewed by August 20 will be invalidated.
